proc.label: Production processes in the installation
proc.help: Define each production process (e.g. sinter plant, blast furnace, steel plant, rolling mill) and the goods it produces. The same CN code can be the output of only one process. If the precursors produced in the installation are not sold, you can define one joint process ('bubble').
proc.eNone: Enter at least one production process.
proc.eJointMin: {{label}}: a joint process must cover at least 2 categories.
proc.eJointNoSale: {{label}}: a joint process is allowed only if no precursor produced within the process is sold or transferred.
proc.eRoute: {{label}}: select a production route for the category “{{category}}”.
proc.eMethodMb: {{label}}: the mass balance method is mandatory for this category.
proc.eNoOutput: {{label}}: enter at least one product (output) of the process.
proc.eActivity: {{label}}: the activity level (sum of produced quantities) must be greater than 0.
proc.eHydrogen: {{what}}: hydrogen (2804 10 00) is not a good of the iron and steel sector.
proc.eOutputCategory: {{what}}: CN {{cn}} belongs to the category “{{category}}”, which this process does not cover.
proc.eCnMulti: CN {{cn}} is the output of several processes ({{processes}}). The same CN code can be the output of only one process.
proc.wNoProcess: The declared product {{cn}} is not the output of any process – the default value will be used for it.
proc.name: Process name
proc.noSaleConfirm: No precursor produced within this process is sold or transferred
proc.mbForced: For this category the carbon in the product, slag and waste is accounted for with the mass balance method – the method is mandatory.
proc.outputsTitle: Process outputs (activity level in the reporting period, t)
proc.outputsHelp: Quantity produced in the reporting period (sold or used as a precursor in another process), excluding waste, off-spec products, by-products and residues.
proc.deleteInfo: Deleting a process also deletes all its rows in the following steps (fuels, mass balance, energy flows, electricity, precursors, parameters).

de.fuelHelp: Enter the fuel consumed in the process. Fuel used to produce heat that is used in several processes is not entered here but as heat (Energy flows step). Enter waste gases imported from another process in the Energy flows step.
de.matHelp: Method A: input carbonate (e.g. limestone CaCO3). Method B: output oxide (e.g. CaO in lime/slag). Share = mass fraction of pure carbonate/oxide in the material.
de.mbHelp: Enter all carbon-containing inputs (fuels, reducing agents, scrap, alloys, electrodes, additives, purchased precursors) and outputs (product, slag, dust). Outputs are subtracted. Do not enter waste gas as an output – its export is entered in the Energy flows step. CO in unpurified waste gas is counted as CO2.
de.eNcvNm3: {{what}}: for the unit 1000 Nm³ enter an NCV (GJ/1000 Nm³) > 0.
de.wBiomass: {{what}}: biomass fraction > 0 – the biomass sustainability criteria are not checked.
de.wWgInFuel: {{what}}: waste gas entered as a fuel – check that imported waste gas is not counted twice.
de.wEfNcvDev: {{what}}: the entered EF/NCV deviates by more than 50 % from the standard value.
de.wEfDevEntered: {{what}}: the entered EF deviates by more than 50 % from the standard value.
de.eMbMaterial: {{what}}: select a material or enter a name.
de.wCcDev: {{what}}: the carbon content deviates by more than 50 % from the standard value.
de.wEfDev: {{what}}: the EF deviates by more than 50 % from the standard value.
de.wMbNoOutput: Process {{id}}: the mass balance has no outputs (carbon in the product/slag is not accounted for).
de.name: Name
de.title: Direct emissions per process
de.titleHelp: Only the tables that match the method selected for each process are shown. Standard values (Annex II G of Regulation 2025/2547) are filled in automatically and can be changed.
de.factorsError: Standard factors were not loaded ({{error}}) – enter the values manually or select “Other”.
de.dropped: {{count}} saved rows do not match the method or an existing process and will be removed when saving.

ef.heatLabel: Measurable heat (import into / export from the process)
ef.heatHelp: Net measurable heat (steam, hot water) in TJ. Heat from exothermic chemical processes and heat recovered from electricity-driven processes has zero emissions.
ef.wgLabel: Waste gases (BFG, BOFG, coke oven gas) – import/export
ef.wgHelp: Import: gas produced in another process and combusted in this one. Export: gas produced in this process and combusted in another (e.g. a power plant). Gases produced and consumed in the same process are not entered here.
ef.elLabel: Electricity produced within the process boundaries
ef.elHelp: Only if electricity is produced from fuels included in this process (Emel,prod in equation 55). EF according to equation 38; for waste gas at most the EF of natural gas is used.
ef.wNoEvidence: {{what}}: without evidence the supplier EF is not used – the standard fuel EF / 0.9 applies.
ef.eFuelForStdNoEvidence: {{what}}: select the fuel for the standard EF (used when there is no evidence).
ef.wWgCap: {{what}}: the mix contains waste gas – for waste gas at most the EF of natural gas (56.1 t CO2/TJ) may be used.
ef.eFuelForStd: {{what}}: select the fuel for the standard EF.
ef.wWgExport: {{what}}: waste gas export without evidence for the verifier – the deduction is not applied.
ef.evidence: Evidence for the verifier is available
ef.mixHasWg: The fuel mix contains waste gas
ef.chpEmField: Emissions of the CHP unit (t CO2)
ef.chpQField: Net heat produced by the CHP (TJ)
ef.wgCapNote: If waste gas is part of the fuel mix and its EF is above 56.1 t CO2/TJ, use 56.1 t CO2/TJ for the waste gas.
ef.title: Energy flows
ef.titleHelp: All entries in this step are optional. Enter only heat and waste gas flows that cross the process boundaries.

el.label: Electricity consumption – only for agglomerated ore (sinter/pellets)
el.help: Indirect emissions are counted only for CN 2601 12 00. For a joint process enter only the consumption of the sinter/pellet plant. If electricity comes from several sources, enter the shares of the sources (weighted average, Art. 9 of Regulation 2025/2547).
el.eMissing: Process {{id}}: an agglomerated ore process must have electricity consumption.
el.wNoEvidence: {{what}}: without evidence the default grid emission factor is used.
el.notNeeded: This step is not needed for your processes.
el.ignored: Previously entered rows ({{count}}) are not used and will be removed.
el.fallback: – country not in the table, “Other countries and territories” is used

rp.label: Additional reporting parameters (iron and steel sector)
rp.help: The parameters are passed to the importer for the CBAM declaration (Annex IV point 2 of Regulation 2025/2547).
rp.none: There are no additional parameters for this category.

pre.help: The mass includes the part that is cut off, burnt or becomes scrap (mi includes scrap). Precursors from the EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland have zero emissions. Actual supplier values may be used only with a verification report; otherwise the default value is used.
pre.eSource: {{what}}: select the process the precursor comes from.
pre.eSelf: {{what}}: a process cannot be its own precursor.
pre.eNoSource: {{what}}: the source process {{id}} does not exist.
pre.eJoint: {{what}}: a precursor cannot come from a joint process ('bubble').
pre.wNotOutput: {{what}}: CN {{cn}} is not an output of process {{id}}.
pre.eCountry: {{what}}: select the country of origin or mark it as unknown.
pre.eActual: {{what}}: enter the actual specific direct emissions of the supplier.
pre.wUnverified: {{what}}: the actual data are not verified – the default value will be used.
pre.eYear: {{what}}: the production year must have four digits.
pre.wYear: {{what}}: for years before 2026 the default value for 2026 is used.
pre.wUnusual: {{what}}: the category “{{category}}” is not a usual precursor for {{process}}.
pre.wMi: Process {{id}}: the precursor mass per tonne of product is {{m}} < 1 – check that cut-off scrap is included.
pre.internal: From another process of this installation
pre.cn8Default: Code must be precise enough for the default value
pre.countryUnknown: The country of production is not known
pre.zeroEu: Precursor originating in the EU – embedded emissions are counted as zero.
pre.zeroExempt: Precursor from a country/territory exempt from CBAM – embedded emissions are counted as zero.
pre.seeIndirectHelp: Only the carried-over indirect emissions of sintered ore.
pre.verified: The data are verified by an accredited verifier
pre.jointNote: Precursors produced within a joint process are not entered as precursors.

pd.eHydrogen: {{what}}: hydrogen (2804 10 00) can be entered only as a precursor, not as declared goods.

code.IS_W_INSTALLATION_MISSING: No installation from the company settings is selected; the installation country is unknown (needed for the default grid factor and the origin check).
code.IS_E_PERIOD: The reporting period must be within one calendar year from 2026 onwards; the import year must be ≥ 2026.
code.IS_E_CN_FORMAT: The CN code must have 4 to 8 digits.
code.IS_E_CN_TOO_SHORT: The CN code is not precise enough: the default values (Annex I to Regulation 2025/2621) differ by sub-code. Enter a more precise code.

code.IS_E_QTY: The quantity must be greater than 0.

code.IS_E_OUTPUT_CATEGORY: The category of the output CN code is not covered by the process.
code.IS_E_JOINT_NOT_ELIGIBLE: A joint process requires ≥ 2 categories and confirmation that the precursors are not sold.
code.IS_E_PRECURSOR_SELF: The precursor refers to the same, an unknown or a joint process.

code.IS_E_SINTER_EL_MISSING: The agglomerated ore process has no electricity consumption entered.

code.IS_W_ATTR_NEGATIVE: Attributed emissions are negative and set to 0 (equation 55).
code.IS_W_MB_NO_OUTPUT: The mass balance has no output rows (carbon in the product/slag).
code.IS_W_MB_NEGATIVE: The mass balance total is negative.
code.IS_W_CC_DEVIATION: The entered factor deviates by more than 50 % from the standard value.
code.IS_W_BIOMASS_UNVERIFIED: The biomass fraction is not checked (sustainability criteria).
code.IS_W_DV_FALLBACK_OTHER: The default value of the table 'Other countries and territories' was used.
code.IS_W_PRECURSOR_UNVERIFIED: The supplier's actual data are not verified – the default value was used.
code.IS_W_PRECURSOR_UNUSUAL: Unusual precursor category for this process.
code.IS_W_MI_BELOW_ONE: Specific precursor consumption < 1 – cut-off scrap is probably not included.
code.IS_W_WG_EXPORT_NO_EVIDENCE: Waste gas export without evidence – no deduction.
code.IS_W_WG_IN_FUEL: Waste gas entered as a fuel – check for double counting.

code.IS_W_EL_NO_EVIDENCE: Electricity EF without evidence – the default grid EF was used.
code.IS_W_EL_IGNORED: Electricity is not counted for this process (direct emissions only).

code.IS_W_ORIGIN_EXEMPT: Goods originating in a country exempt from CBAM (Annex III).
code.IS_W_ORIGIN_MISMATCH: The product's country of origin differs from the installation country.
code.IS_W_PRODUCT_NO_PROCESS_DEFAULT_USED: The product is not the output of any process – the default value was used.
code.IS_W_ORPHAN_ROW: A row refers to a non-existent process and was ignored.
code.IS_W_REPORTING_PARAM_MISSING: A mandatory reporting parameter is missing.

general.title: Cement – general data
general.yearLabel: Year of import of the goods into the EU
general.yearHelp: Used to select the default value with mark-up (2026: 10 %, 2027: 20 %, from 2028: 30 %, Annex I to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1740). For goods imported in 2026 the reporting period is 2026 (Art. 7 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2547).

general.sourceHelp: Default values: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 as corrected by Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1740. Actual values require installation monitoring data and verification by an accredited verifier.
general.installationHelp: Installation from Settings where the goods were produced.

pd.title: Product details – cement
pd.intro: Enter each imported product: CN code (one of the 6 cement codes of Annex I to Regulation 2023/956), TARIC where required, quantity in tonnes of good, country of origin and the clinker content for cement.
pd.name: Product name
pd.ckActualInfo: The clinker content is required for cement (2523 21 00, 2523 29 00, 2523 90 00) when you calculate with actual data (functional unit: t clinker contained, Art. 4(5) of Regulation 2025/2547).
pd.mappingError: CN codes could not be loaded: {{error}}
pd.dialogText: For clinker (2523 10 00), other hydraulic cements (2523 90 00) and calcined clay (2507 00 80) the default values depend on the TARIC subdivision (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1740, recitals 5–6).
pd.whiteDefinition: White cement clinker (help for the choice, point 5.2.1 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2620): average contents of at most 0.4 mass-% Fe2O3, 0.003 mass-% Cr2O3 and 0.03 mass-% Mn2O3; all other clinker is grey.
pd.rangeRule: Cement in ranges of composition: ranges “shall not be larger than 10 %” (Annex III B of Regulation 2025/2547). Enter the clinker content of the consignment or range.

proc.label: Production processes in the installation
proc.help: Define each production process (e.g. clinker kiln, cement mill, clay calcination) and the goods leaving it. The same CN/TARIC code may leave only one process. If clinker (and calcined clay) produced in the installation is neither sold nor used in other processes, you may define one joint process ('bubble').
proc.name: Process name
proc.jointCategory: Output of the joint process: cement
proc.noSaleConfirm: I confirm that the clinker / calcined clay produced in the installation is neither sold nor used in other processes.
proc.jointHelp: A joint process must cover cement and at least one precursor category (Art. 4(9) of Regulation 2025/2547; Guidance 05a p. 26). White and grey cement in one process are allowed (open question OQ-CE-1); separate processes are recommended.
proc.outputsHelp: Quantity produced in the reporting period (t good). Only goods that can be sold or used directly as a precursor – not off-spec products, by-products or waste.
proc.alPreview: Activity level: {{fu}} t (functional unit) · {{mass}} t good
proc.deleteInfo: Deleting a process also deletes all its rows in the following steps.
proc.eJoint_categories: {{label}}: a joint process must cover cement and at least one of the categories clinker / calcined clay.
proc.eJoint_confirmation: {{label}}: a joint process is allowed only with the confirmation that the precursors are not sold.

de.title: Direct emissions
de.titleHelp: Enter the data per process. Calculate the clinker process emissions with Method A (input) or Method B (clinker output), never both for the same process.
de.fuelHelp: Enter all kiln fuels (conventional, alternative fossil, biomass/waste) and non-kiln fuels (drying, calciners). For waste fuels enter the biomass fraction. Fuel for heat used in more than one process is entered as heat (Energy flows step).
de.matHelp: Carbonates in raw materials or raw meal as a whole, non-carbonate carbon, carbonates for flue gas scrubbing, urea in de-NOx. Do not enter the raw material corresponding to discarded dust (CKD) here. Blank EF for a Table 3/4 code = standard value.
de.eEfOrCc: {{what}}: enter the EF or the carbon content.
de.rawMealRatioHelp: Site-specific empirical ratio, updated at least once a year (Annex II B.9.2.1).
de.cliLabel: Clinker process emissions – Method B (clinker output based)
de.cliHelp: Clinker quantity by direct weighing or by the cement-deliveries balance (Equation 27). Minimum requirement: emission factor 0.525 t CO2/t clinker (Annex II B.9.2.2 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2547).
de.efAnalysisHelp: Value from clinker analysis (recommended improvement). A correction for non-carbonate CaO/MgO is not calculated (open question OQ-CE-3).
de.eEfAnalysis: {{what}}: the EF from analysis must be > 0.
de.balanceTitle: Balance: Cli = Σ (Cem_deliv − Cem_SV) × CCR − Cli_s + Cli_d − Cli_SV
de.balanceHelp: Formula as printed (Equation 27, Annex II B.9.2.2). The sign of the stock variations is not defined by the sources; interpretation “variation = opening − closing stock” (open question OQ-CE-2). Blank fields are sent as 0.
de.ckdLabel: Discarded cement kiln dust (CKD) / bypass dust
de.ckdHelp: Only dust leaving the kiln system. Do not enter the raw material corresponding to this dust as a Method A input.
de.dHelp: Entered in %, used as d/100 (open question OQ-CE-15).
de.ckdPreview: Preview: EF_CKD = {{ef}} t CO2/t → {{em}} t CO2

ef.title: Energy flows
ef.titleHelp: Measurable heat imported into or exported from the process (e.g. kiln heat exported to district heating) and electricity produced in the process.
ef.heatHelp: Net heat in TJ. Export, e.g. kiln heat exported to district heating, is subtracted from the process emissions.
ef.elHelp: Emissions of electricity produced in the process are subtracted from the direct emissions (Equation 55).

el.label: Electricity consumption per process
el.help: Indirect emissions are counted for all cement goods. Default grid factor: Annex II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621. Actual factor only with a direct technical link or a power purchase agreement (PPA) and evidence. For a joint process enter the total consumption.
el.jointNote: Joint process: enter the total consumption without split.

pre.label: Precursors (clinker, calcined clay)
pre.help: Mass includes losses. Precursors from the EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland have zero emissions. Gypsum, slag, fly ash and other additives are not precursors.
pre.notNeeded: This step is not needed for your processes.
pre.jointNote: Clinker produced inside the joint process is not entered; additionally purchased clinker is.
pre.annexIv: Annex IV – unknown country of production

p.title: Cost calculator
p.introExporter: For non-EU exporters: compare what your EU buyer pays in CBAM certificates under official defaults versus your actual (verified) emissions — after the calculation and verification costs you enter below.
p.introImporter: For EU importers: compare total CBAM-related costs using official default values versus actual emissions plus calculation and verification costs.
p.introSame: Same goods, quantities, origin and price assumptions in both scenarios.
p.whyTitle: Why actual emissions can be cheaper than defaults
p.linesHelp: Add one line per product, origin and import period. Official defaults are looked up from IR 2025/2621 for each line. Actual SEE and SEFA are optional per line; lines without them use default values in both scenarios.
p.otherTitle: Other CBAM imports by the same importer (50 t exemption)
p.otherHelp: The 50 t threshold applies to the importer’s total net mass of CBAM goods per calendar year, all CN codes together (hydrogen and electricity excluded). Enter imports not listed above. Leave empty if unknown: lines totalling 50 t or less will then show “insufficient information”.
p.priceHelp: Assumed prices for forecasting only — not official prices. Edit them to your own low, central and high view. Results using these prices are labelled “Forecast”.
p.official2026Help: Official 2026 quarterly prices (optional). 2026 imports use the quarterly average price of the quarter of importation (Art. 21(1a)). An entered price replaces the assumed price for that quarter.
p.costsHelpExporter: Prefills treat consultancy and verification as paid by the producer/exporter. Use allocation share if one installation fee covers several customers. Costs with amount 0 are ignored.
p.costsHelpImporter: Enter your own estimates. Use allocation share to avoid double-counting installation-level fees across products or customers. Costs with amount 0 are ignored. Producer-only costs appear only in the combined view.
p.shareHelp: e.g. 0.25 if this import is 25% of the installation volume covered by the fee
p.yearHelp: Each import year is compared separately: certificates are surrendered per calendar year (Art. 22(1)) and the 50 t threshold is assessed per year (Art. 2a). One-off costs are counted once, in {{year}} (the first year with actual data); other years show recurring costs.
p.importerOnlyInfo: Importer-only view hides producer-paid verification/consultancy. Turn on combined view to see your exporter cost burden against the buyer’s certificate saving.
p.stIncomplete: Incomplete — some lines could not be estimated
p.partialTotals: Partial totals: the comparison below covers only lines that could be estimated. Lines marked “insufficient info” or “not implemented” are excluded, not counted as €0.
p.certDiffExporter: Certificate cost for your EU buyer (default − actual):
p.addCostsExporter: Your additional calculation / verification costs (first year):
p.disclaimer: Screening estimate only. Default values and benchmarks come from IR (EU) 2025/2621 and 2025/2620 extracts in this app. Foreign carbon-price deductions are not quantified (see open questions). CBAM factor / CSCF use Guidance Doc. No. 4 pending binding acts in the source folder. Not legal advice.

r.notListed: CN code not listed in Annex I. {{src}}

d.required: Line {{n}}: enter a CN code, country of origin and a positive quantity.
d.sefa: Line {{n}}: enter the supplier's SEFA for the actual-emissions scenario, or clear actual SEE.

a.why1: Official default values include a mark-up: 10 % for 2026, 20 % for 2027 and 30 % from 2028 (1 % for fertilisers).
a.why2: The Commission notes that, because of this mark-up, using actual values should in most cases be more advantageous than default values where actual values are available.
a.why3: The number of CBAM certificates follows the embedded emissions declared, after the free-allocation adjustment — so a lower verified SEE means fewer certificates for the EU importer.
a.why4: Actual emissions are not automatically cheaper: a high SEE, low volume or expensive verification can make defaults the better option. Who pays calculation and verification is a commercial matter — set it per cost item below.
a.certDown: For your EU buyer, using actual emissions is estimated to reduce CBAM certificate costs by {{v}}
a.certUp: For your EU buyer, using actual emissions is estimated to INCREASE CBAM certificate costs by {{v}}
a.scopeCombined: combined producer–importer cost (non-EU exporter and EU buyer together)
a.scopeImporter: the EU importer’s own cost (costs paid by you as non-EU exporter and not passed on are excluded)
a.main: {{cert}}. Additional calculation, verification and reporting costs counted in this view: {{add}} in the first year. The estimated net effect on {{scope}} is {{net}} for the selected period. In later years (recurring costs only) the net {{kind}} is {{rec}} per year.
a.outweigh: Certificate costs fall, but the additional costs outweigh that under these assumptions — check the break-even volume and sensitivity.
a.noReduce: Under these assumptions actual emissions do not reduce certificate costs compared with default values.

pd.title: Goods (Aluminium II)
pd.intro: Enter every declared good with its 8-digit CN code, quantity in tonnes and country of origin. The goods category (unwrought aluminium / aluminium products) follows from the CN code.
pd.name: Product name
pd.mappingError: The CN list could not be loaded: {{error}}
pd.indirectInfo: For aluminium only direct emissions are counted (CBAM-R Annex II).
pd.dialogText: CBAM covers the following aluminium headings (Regulation (EU) 2023/956, Annex I). 4- and 6-digit headings include all 8-digit codes starting with the same digits.
pd.excluded: Not CBAM goods: {{codes}} (aluminium waste and scrap; household articles).
pd.eightDigitRule: Declared goods, process outputs and precursors need exactly 8 digits, because default values differ below heading level. The suggestions come from the CBAM communication template; any 8-digit code under a heading is accepted.

general.yearLabel: Year of import of the goods into the EU
general.yearHelp: Used to select the default value with mark-up (2026: 10 %, 2027: 20 %, from 2028: 30 %, Annex I to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1740). For goods imported in 2026 the reporting period is 2026 (Art. 7 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2547).
general.yearError: The year of import must be 2026 or later (definitive period).
general.sourceLabel: On which data do you calculate the embedded emissions?
general.sourceHelp: For aluminium only direct emissions (CO2 and PFCs) are counted; indirect emissions of electricity are not included (Annex II to Regulation (EU) 2023/956). Actual values require monitoring data and verification by an accredited verifier.
general.optionsMissing: The answer options are missing in the database. Please contact support.
general.installationHelp: Installation from Settings where the goods were produced.
general.dvPreviewNote: Values from the backend (total × (1 + mark-up), Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1740). The final calculation happens on the result page.

proc.label: Production processes in the installation
proc.help: Define each production process (e.g. electrolysis and cast house = unwrought aluminium; rolling, extrusion = aluminium products) and the goods leaving it. Primary and secondary production of unwrought aluminium in the same installation form one process. Products differing only in size or shape belong to the same process. The same CN code may leave only one process. Scrap is not a process output.
proc.name: Process name
proc.jointCategory: Joint process: outputs are aluminium products only.
proc.routesHelp: Unwrought aluminium (and a joint process) needs at least one route; tick both if the installation smelts and recycles.
proc.productsNoRoute: Aluminium products have no production route.
proc.noSaleConfirm: I confirm that unwrought aluminium produced in the installation is neither sold nor transferred out of the installation
proc.jointHelp: A joint process is only possible if no intermediate product is sold or transferred out of the installation (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2547 Art. 4(9); Guidance 05e p. 20).
proc.outputsHelp: Liquid aluminium directly charged to products production is entered as unwrought aluminium (7601). Quantity = tonnes produced in the reporting period; off-spec products, by-products, waste and scrap are not entered.
proc.deleteInfo: Rows of deleted processes in the later steps are deleted on Next.
proc.eJoint_categories: {{label}}: a joint process must cover both unwrought aluminium and aluminium products.
proc.eJoint_confirmation: {{label}}: confirm that no unwrought aluminium is sold or transferred out of the installation.
proc.eRouteProducts: {{label}}: aluminium products have no production route.

de.titleHelp: Direct emissions per process: fuels, anodes / electrode paste (primary smelting only) and flue gas treatment. PFC emissions follow in the next step.
de.fuelHelp: All fuels of stationary units inside the process boundary: drying and pre-heating, heating of electrolysis cells, melting and holding furnaces, scrap pre-treatment, casting, annealing. Do not enter mobile machinery or cutting, welding and finishing. Fuel for heat used in more than one process is entered as heat.
de.wDeviation: {{what}}: EF or NCV deviates by more than 50 % from the standard value – please check.
de.anodeHelp: Net consumption = anode input (own + purchased) minus anode stumps returned. Emission factor = carbon content × 3,664 t CO2/t C (Equation 9 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2547). There is no standard factor for anodes – enter the analysed carbon content. Anodes and alumina have no embedded emissions; emissions of anode production are not entered.
de.anodeEfHelp: If entered, the EF is used instead of the carbon content.
de.anodePreview: Net consumption {{net}} t · EF {{ef}} t CO2/t · emissions {{em}} t CO2
de.flueLabel: Flue gas treatment and other process materials
de.flueHelp: Soda ash, limestone or other carbonates used in flue gas treatment (Method A), alternatively gypsum produced in desulphurisation (Method B), and urea in de-NOx.
de.fluePreviewFixed: EF {{ef}} t CO2/t · emissions {{em}} t CO2

pfc.label: Perfluorocarbon (PFC) emissions from anode effects
pfc.help: Methods A and B are equivalent; choose the one you have data for. Minimum requirement: technology-specific factors of Table 2/3 of Annex II B.7 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2547; recommended: installation-specific factors (measured at least every 3 years, uncertainty ± 15 %). Total PFC emissions = duct emissions / collection efficiency (Equation 20). GWP: CF4 6 630, C2F6 11 100 t CO2e/t.
pfc.aemHelp: If entered, used instead of frequency × duration.
pfc.tableMissing: No table factor for this technology and method – use installation-specific factors.
pfc.preview: AEM {{aem}} · CF4 {{cf4}} t · C2F6 {{c2f6}} t · duct {{duct}} t CO2e · total {{total}} t CO2e
pfc.gwpMissing: GWP values could not be loaded – CO2e preview not available.
pfc.tableTitle: Technology-specific factors (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2547 Annex II B.7, Table 2 / Table 3)
pfc.tableError: PFC factors could not be loaded: {{error}}

ef.titleHelp: Measurable heat imported to or exported from the process and electricity produced inside the process boundary. Electricity consumption is not entered for aluminium.
ef.heatLabel: Measurable heat (imported to / exported from the process)
ef.heatHelp: Heat recovered from electricity-driven processes is not accounted for (EF = 0, Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2547 Annex III A.3, p. 71).
ef.elLabel: Electricity produced within the process boundary
ef.elHelp: Only if electricity is produced from fuels included in this process (Emel,prod in Equation 55). Electricity consumption is not entered for aluminium.

pre.label: Precursors (unwrought aluminium, aluminium products)
pre.help: Mass includes losses (mass entering the process). Precursors from the EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland have zero emissions. Scrap, alumina and anodes are not precursors. Supplier actual values only with a verification report; otherwise the default value.
pre.unwroughtNote: Unwrought aluminium from other sources is a precursor of secondary melting only (7601 codes).
pre.jointNote: Unwrought aluminium produced inside the joint process is not entered; purchased additional unwrought aluminium or products may be.

rp.label: Reporting parameters (Annex IV point 2 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2547)
rp.help: One row per process. These parameters are reported for the goods and do not change the embedded emissions.
rp.scrap: Scrap used in the reporting period (t)
rp.otherElements: Total content of elements other than aluminium (%) – reported if above 1 %

err.AL2_E_PERIOD: {{what}} The reporting period must be one calendar year from 2026 on; the year of import must be ≥ 2026.
err.AL2_E_CN_FORMAT: {{what}}: the CN code must have exactly 8 digits.
err.AL2_E_CN_EXCLUDED: {{what}}: CN 7602 (waste and scrap) and 7615 (household articles) are not CBAM goods.
err.AL2_E_CN_NOT_CBAM_ALUMINIUM: {{what}}: the CN code is not a CBAM good of the aluminium sector.
err.AL2_E_QTY: {{what}}: the quantity must be greater than 0 (≥ 0 where allowed).
err.AL2_E_FACTOR_RANGE: {{what}}: factor (OF, CF, η, EF, NCV, SEF, OVC, F) outside the allowed range or missing.
err.AL2_E_CN_MULTI_PROCESS: The same CN code leaves more than one process: {{what}}.
err.AL2_E_OUTPUT_CATEGORY: {{what}}: the category of this output is not allowed for the process.
err.AL2_E_ROUTE_MISSING: {{what}}: an unwrought aluminium process (or joint process) needs a route.
err.AL2_E_JOINT_NOT_ELIGIBLE: {{what}}: a joint process needs both categories and the confirmation that unwrought aluminium is not sold or transferred.
err.AL2_E_ANODE_ROUTE: {{what}}: anode consumption is only allowed for primary smelting.
err.AL2_E_ANODE_NET_NEGATIVE: {{what}}: the anode stumps returned exceed the anode input.
err.AL2_E_ANODE_EF_MISSING: {{what}}: enter the carbon content or the emission factor.
err.AL2_E_PFC_ROUTE: {{what}}: PFC emissions are only allowed for primary smelting.
err.AL2_E_PFC_INCOMPLETE: {{what}}: the data for the selected PFC method are incomplete.
err.AL2_E_PFC_FACTOR_MISSING: {{what}}: PFC factors are missing (the table has no values for this technology / method).
err.AL2_E_PRECURSOR_CATEGORY: {{what}}: this precursor is not allowed for the process category.
err.AL2_E_PRECURSOR_ROUTE: {{what}}: unwrought aluminium is a precursor only with secondary melting.
err.AL2_E_PRECURSOR_SOURCE: {{what}}: the source process must be a single process with this CN code as output.
err.AL2_E_PRECURSOR_ACTUAL_MISSING: {{what}}: the actual value of the precursor is missing.
err.AL2_E_PROCESS_INVALID: {{what}} No result because the process contains an error.
err.AL2_W_ATTR_NEGATIVE: {{what}}: attributed emissions are negative and set to 0 (Equation 55).
err.AL2_W_BIOMASS_UNVERIFIED: {{what}}: the biomass share is not checked (sustainability criteria).
err.AL2_W_DV_FALLBACK_OTHER: {{what}} The default value of the table “Other countries and territories” is used.
err.AL2_W_DV_DVC_CORRECTION: {{what}} Default value or route taken from the correction in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1740.
err.AL2_W_PRECURSOR_UNVERIFIED: {{what}}: supplier actual data are not verified – the default value is used.
err.AL2_W_MI_BELOW_ONE: {{what}}: the precursor mass is lower than the product mass (Σ m_i = {{m}}) – please check the quantities.
err.AL2_W_ANODE_MISSING: {{what}}: no anode consumption entered for primary smelting.
err.AL2_W_PFC_MISSING: {{what}}: no PFC emissions entered for primary smelting.
err.AL2_W_PFC_NO_COLLECTION_EFF: {{what}}: collection efficiency not entered – 100 % is used.
err.AL2_W_PFC_PFPB_MW_CWPB: {{what}}: the CWPB values are used for PFPB MW.
err.AL2_W_PFC_PRAL_GT_AL: {{what}}: primary aluminium production exceeds the process output.
err.AL2_W_FLUE_GAS_A_AND_B: {{what}}: carbonates (Method A) and gypsum (Method B) – confirm that these are different scrubbers.
err.AL2_W_INSTALLATION_MISSING: {{what}} No installation from the company settings selected; the installation country is unknown.
err.AL2_W_ORIGIN_EU: {{what}}: EU origin – not subject to CBAM.
err.AL2_W_ORIGIN_MISMATCH: {{what}}: the country of origin differs from the installation country.
err.AL2_W_PRODUCT_NO_PROCESS_DEFAULT_USED: {{what}}: the product is not an output of any process – the default value is used.
err.AL2_W_ORPHAN_ROW: {{what}} A row refers to a non-existent process and is ignored.

element.1: Date and version number of the monitoring plan
element.2: Description of the installation and production processes
element.3: Goods produced by CN code and functional unit (clinker / nitrogen content, precursors not covered by separate processes)
element.4: CBAM production processes and routes, goods delivered per process
element.5: Non-CBAM goods produced per production process and quantity
element.6: Relevant CBAM benchmarks for the free allocation adjustment
element.7: Methods for monitoring data per production process (calculation / measurement systems)
element.8: Methods for determining calculation factors and sampling plan
element.9: Source streams and emission sources per production process
element.10: Source streams under the standard method or the mass balance method (B.3.4)
element.11: Emission sources under a measurement-based methodology (B.6)
element.12: Monitoring methodology for PFCs from primary aluminium production
element.13: Diagram and process description with system boundaries (no double counting, no data gaps)
element.14: Precursors per production process; supplier name and country if produced elsewhere
element.15: Zero-rated fuels and how their zero-rating is demonstrated
element.16: Measurable heat imported / exported, partner installations and methods
element.17: Electricity produced inside the installation (co-generation, separate, fossil/renewable, exported)
element.18: Evidence for indirect emissions based on actual emissions (D.4.3)
element.19: Evidence for embedded emissions of electricity imported into the EU based on actual emissions (D.2.4)
element.20: Waste gases produced, used, imported or exported, partner installations
element.21: CO2 capture, storage and/or use (B.8.2, B.8.3)
